{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7 (+0.012/0)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 14 H7 (+0.018/0)"}],"comment":"The part is zinc plated (title block surface_treatment: \"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)\") but the H7 holes D4 and D5 carry no allowance for plating thickness, so the finished bores will be undersize and mating pins or bearings may not fit. The designer should either add a plating-thickness allowance to these hole tolerances or specify masking of the bores during plating."

,"recommended_correction":"Add plating allowance to the H7 hole tolerances or call out masking of the bores before plating."}]}
